actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet low, conserve to 30% (0.81) then conditional cooperation adds extra 30% (0.81) = 1.62 contribution. Round 6 requires norm broadcast.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action now round=6 observed. Wallet 2.7, below 30% of initial (30). Conserve says reduce contribution to 30% of wallet =0.81. But also conditional cooperation: average contribution each round? Compute avg last round: round6 contributions: Resident2 gave 10.8, others 0, total pool 10.8, per agent share 2.7. Average contribution = total_pool/6 =1.8. That's 1.8% of endowment, below 30% threshold, also below 30% of endowment (30). Conditional says if avg falls below 30% of endowment, increase your contribution by extra 30% of wallet to push group back up. Baseline currently would be conserve 30% of wallet=0.81. Increase by extra 30% of wallet =0.3*2.7=0.81, so total contribution =0.81+0.81=1.62. Must also ensure not exceed wallet 2.7, fine.

Punish free-riders: need check any agent contributed less than 10% of endowment (10) for two consecutive rounds. Resident1 contributed 0 in rounds2-6 many zeros, that's two consecutive low rounds -> should punish. But punishment cost 0.3 per severity unit, we have limited wallet 2.7, can afford small. Use amount 10 severity costs 3 which we cannot afford. So maybe skip punish. Could punish amount 5 cost 1.5, okay. Constitution says punish free riders using amount 10 cost to you =3, but if can't afford, skip. We could choose not to punish.

Also need broadcast norm every 5 rounds: round6 is not multiple of5? Round numbers start at 1? Our round count is 6, broadcast required at round1 and every 5 rounds thereafter i.e., rounds1,6,11... So need broadcast. So we must broadcast a norm message. Also can contribute. So actions: contribute 1.62 and broadcast.

Return JSON.
